why_agent_cannot: an email confirmation link must be opened by the human
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Chaos Labs site Go to the Chaos Labs home page to see the AI products and customers the company describes.
2 Step 2 : Read about Chaos AI Open the Introducing Chaos AI post to see how Chaos Labs describes Chaos AI.
3 Step 3 : Open the Chaos AI sign-up page Go to the Chaos AI sign-up page , which presents the waitlist.
4 Step 4 : Join the waitlist Enter your email on the sign-up page, or continue with Google or X, to join the waitlist. The page also mentions linking a crypto wallet.
5 Step 5 : Browse the research and news Read the research and news pages for what Chaos Labs publishes about its products.
